items.title: Functional Group Interconversion (aik functional group ko doosre mein badalna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of functional group interconversion with Quick Check 25.1 answered (PDF 136-137). Answers need review.

blocks.text: FGI (functional group interconversion) aik functional group ko doosre functional group mein badalne ka process hai, jo kisi khaas compound ki synthesis ke liye zaroori ho. Target molecule tak le jane wale raaste banane mein FGI ka bohat important role hai. FGI ko building blocks ki tarah istemal kar ke simple starting materials ko zyada complex (mushkil) target molecules mein badla ja sakta hai. FGI se na sirf target molecule ka carbon skeleton (carbon dhaancha) banta hai balke yeh bhi tay hota hai ke kaun sa raasta (route) apnaya jaye.
Functional groups ki yeh interconversions hum pichhle chapters mein detail se parh chuke hain; un ka summary Figure 25.3 aur 25.4 mein diya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Do carbon wale compounds ke beech interconversions ka map: alkene, halogenoalkane, amine, aldehyde, alcohol, amide, ester, carboxylic acid aur acid halide; arrows par reagents: HBr, KOH (alcohol), NH3, Heat/H2SO4, H2O/H2SO4, PBr3, KOH (aq), K2Cr2O7/H2SO4, NaBH4, V2O5, LiAlH4, C2H5OH/H+, SOCl2.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.3: Aliphatic organic compounds mein functional group interconversion (kitab ki Figure 25.3 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har arrow aik reaction hai jo pichhle chapters mein parha. Arrow par likha reagent batata hai ke change kis cheez se hota hai, maslan alcohol K₂Cr₂O₇/H₂SO₄ se aldehyde aur phir carboxylic acid banta hai, aur LiAlH₄ ulta reduction karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Figure 25.3 mein alcohol se amide tak aik arrow “NH₃” bhi chhapa hai. Yeh sahi nahi: ethanol ammonia se ethanamide nahi banata, kyun ke amide ke liye carbonyl group chahiye. Is liye hamare diagram mein yeh arrow nahi rakha gaya. Amide carboxylic acid ya acid halide se NH₃ ke saath banta hai.

blocks.alt: Beech mein benzene: CH3Cl/AlCl3 se oopar toluene; SO3/H2SO4 se baen benzene sulfonic acid, phir (i) NaOH (ii) HCl se neeche phenol; HNO3/H2SO4 se daen nitrobenzene, phir Sn, HCl se neeche aniline; ethanoyl chloride/AlCl3 se neeche acetophenone. Toluene se (i) Cl2, light (ii) KOH(aq) ke zariye benzyl alcohol aur KMnO4/H2SO4 se benzoic acid.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.4: Aromatic organic compounds mein functional group interconversion (kitab ki Figure 25.4 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Benzene se teen electrophilic substitution reactions (alkylation, sulphonation, nitration) aur aik acylation shuru hoti hai; phir doosra step naya group deta hai, maslan nitrobenzene Sn, HCl se aniline ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Figure 25.4 mein naam “benene sulfonic acid” chhapa hai; sahi spelling “benzene sulfonic acid” hain.

blocks.prompt: i) Aldehydes aur ketones nucleophilic addition reaction aasani se kyun karte hain?
blocks.explanation: C=O group polar hai, is liye carbonyl carbon par δ+ charge hota hai jo nucleophile ko kheenchta hai. Is ka π bond aasani se toot jata hai, aur trigonal planar (hamwar) carbonyl carbon par oopar ya neeche se attack ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: ii) Carboxylic acid ko us ke anhydride mein badlein.
blocks.explanation:
Tareeqa 1: do acid molecules ko strong dehydrating agent (paani nikalne wali cheez), jaise P₄O₁₀, ke saath garam karein:
2CH₃COOH → (CH₃CO)₂O + H₂O
Tareeqa 2: acid ko SOCl₂ se acyl chloride banayein, phir us ke sodium salt se react karayein:
CH₃COCl + CH₃COONa → (CH₃CO)₂O + NaCl

items: FGI: aik functional group ko doosre mein badalna.
Figure 25.3 aliphatic aur Figure 25.4 aromatic compounds ki FGI ka khulasa hain.
Arrow par likha reagent batata hai ke change kis se hota hai.
